Core Principles

🔓

Open Model First

Built for open models. Zero vendor lock-in — run any model, anywhere, locally.

🤝

Agent-to-Agent Protocol

Agents talk directly to each other. No orchestrator bottleneck. True swarm intelligence.

🪶

Minimal Dependencies

Lean stack. No bloated abstractions. Just what you need to run agents at scale.

🛡️

Safety by Design

Sandboxed execution + heuristic safety checkpoints. Dangerous actions are intercepted — real autonomy, real guardrails.

⚡

Fast & Reliable

Optimized for speed. Async-first architecture built for production workloads.

🌟

Open Source

Community-driven spirit, with enterprise discipline. Built transparently, governed openly.

Features

🧠

Independent Agents

True independent agents, not sub-agents. Each has its own role, memory, and workplace. Direct agent-to-agent messaging, no middleman.

🌐

Anywhere Workplaces

Run agents locally or remotely, even behind NAT without a public IP. Your workplace, your rules, no network gymnastics.

📦

Sandbox Execution

Every agent runs in an isolated sandbox. Peace of mind knowing your system is protected from unexpected agent behavior.

🔍

Heuristic Safety Checking

Early detection of risky agent behavior across the swarm. Catch anomalies before they cascade, proactive, not reactive.

🛠️

Skills

Not just prompts, skills come with real tools. Skills without tools are like a craftsman without a toolbox

📋

Plugins

Plugins to enrich your workflow. Pre-included kanban plugin, a powerful plugins for managing the agentic work.

In Action

Web Dashboard

Manage your agents, monitor swarm activity, and track tasks from a clean, modern interface.

CLI Interface

Powerful command-line tools for managing agents, plugins, and workflows from your terminal.
